about_the_game:
This is a professional software observability tool. A monthly subscription is required. Visit our website to create your account and get started. Once your application is generating OpenTelemetry data, download the Immersive APM client and step inside.

Join us on Discord or email us for help.

Enter the World of Your Application®

Stop searching dashboards. Start seeing your system.

Immersive APM, by Immersive Fusion, is a 3D and VR application performance monitoring platform. Instead of switching between tabs, charts, and log files, you step inside a living, spatial view of your distributed system — traces, metrics, and logs rendered in real time around you.

Problems that hide in flat dashboards become obvious in three dimensions. Bottlenecks reveal themselves. Dependencies become clear. Understanding replaces investigation.

See it. Don't search for it.

  • Explore your application topology in an interactive 3D environment

  • Navigate services, traces, and dependencies spatially — on desktop or in VR

  • Spot bottlenecks, failures, and anomalies at a glance

  • Perform root cause analysis in minutes, not hours

Tessa - Your AI Assistant

Every paid tier includes Tessa, an AI Assistant purpose-built for observability. Ask questions in chat or by voice. Tessa queries your traces, metrics, and service maps, then explains what's happening and why — so you don't need to be a senior SRE to troubleshoot like one.

Built on OpenTelemetry. No lock-in.

Immersive APM is 100% OpenTelemetry native. If your application sends OTLP data (gRPC or HTTP), it works. .NET, Java, Python, Go, Node.js - any language with OTel support. No proprietary agents. No vendor lock-in. You own your data.

Desktop. Web. VR.

Use the 3D desktop client for deep investigation. Use the web portal for quick checks and dashboards. Put on a headset and walk through your system in virtual reality.

Supported VR hardware (experimental): Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3, Meta Quest Pro, HTC Vive.

Who it's for

DevOps engineers, SREs, infrastructure teams, software architects, and support organizations managing distributed systems who are tired of dashboard fatigue and want a fundamentally different way to understand their applications.

name: Immersive APM

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit (Service Pack 1)
  • Processor: 4 Cores, 3.0 GHz processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX® 12 capable 3GB GPU
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: Most OpenXR compatible devices
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 11 64-bit
  • Processor: 6 Cores, 3.5 GHz processor
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX® 12 capable 8GB GPU
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: Most OpenXR compatible devices

short_description: Immersive APM transforms how engineers monitor and manage software applications. Immersive APM leverages advanced web, 3D, and VR technologies to provide a fully interactive, three-dimensional view of application telemetry in real-time.
